processing.frontPair: pan=stereo|c0=c0|c1=c1 (front ORTF L/R of the 8ch ORTF 3D master)
processing.loopStartRationale: start chosen so the 6s wrap head matches its tail at P=409s; trimming from 0 put a fade-in against a settled tail
processing.loudnorm: two-pass linear, I=-19.98 LUFS, TP=-1.0 dBTP

wrapPatch.why: loopify-scenes.py never mixed the wrap crossfade tail in (afade ran before asetpts), so the loop wrapped into a fade-up from near silence every P seconds. Repaired in place: the arc around the wrap is replaced by a spectrum-matched stretch of this file with equal-power crossfades; sample count unchanged. DECISIONS.md, 'The wrap was a hole'.

notes: Front ORTF pair from 8ch ORTF 3D master; see notes/personal-sounds-selection-2026-08-17.md Seamless-looped to 409s (prime loopOffset) for native Howler looping: 6s fade-wrap of the post-loop tail over the head so the loop point is gapless. Encoded as Opus (128k) — see DECISIONS.md 'Ship scene audio as Opus, not MP3'.
